tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma bsnyen cing stong mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga'i lag len gsal bar khrigs sdebs 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// tshe dpag med dngos skyabs kyi mchog /rnam par rgyal mar rtag btud nas// rang gzhan 'chi med 'thob bya'i phyir// gang de mchod pa'i thabs tshul bri// 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma rnam par rgyal ma bsnyen cing stong mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga khrigs bsdebs lag tu blang ba'i tshul la/ stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng du bum pa spyi mthun bshams bum pa'i steng du gzungs 'di'i snying po can gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhugs su gsol/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog de nas rim bzhin mchod yon zhabs bsil nas zhal zas kyi bar g.yas skor du bshams/ mdun du yi dam gyi gtor ma dkar zlum 'dab brgyad/ rgyan gsum brtsegs rtse mo byi'u mchu cung zad dod pa/ stong mchod byed na/ lha bshos/ mar me/ bdug spos rnams re re bzhin stong du tshang ba dgos pas/ de dag stegs bur bshams nas bum pa'i phyogs bzhi nas bskor/ gdugs dang ba dan yang 'grub na stong dang ma 'grub na ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ de yang ras sam dar gyi tshal pa phra mos kyang rung bar bshad/ de dag gi nye skor stegs dma' bar cha gsum gtor ma/ skabs su gang babs zhig tu gtor chung ril bu stong dang*/ de bshams pa'i snod bcas 'du bar byas/ cho ga dngos la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badzra amṛta kuṇḍali han han hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swabhāwa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswabhāwa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me dri chab/ zhal zas rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rol mo dang*/ 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shapta swā hā/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ni ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ti/ pradzña pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wi te badzra dharma hṛd ya ni/ santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ rol chen gyis byin dbab/ mchod pa byin rlabs 'og ma rnams la dharma ra ṇi dang rol chen mi dgos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi/ bdag mdun gyi cho ga'i rim pa ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mthar dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyi bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma rnam rgyal lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar te/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi sha bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra titstsha swā hā/

de bzhin/ pā dyaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar thog mtha' 'gro bas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi spyi mthun/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i sa 'dzin gyi steng du them skas dang bcas pa'i khri la/ sna tshogs padma/ de'i steng du rin po che'i rang bzhin mchod rten bang rim zlum po gsum pa/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bre/ gdugs bcu gsum char khegs tog rnams brtsegs shing*/ me tog gi 'phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi lda ldis mdzes par byas pa/ de'i bum pa'i nang du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bhrūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas padma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa bsnams pa/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang po zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang bcas pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas rnga yab dang*/ g.yon padma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/

g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po g.yas rnga yab dang*/ g.yon rdo rje sngon po 'dzin pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi phyogs bzhir khro bo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing ga rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod cing spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs su byas pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyi rgyan can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o// gtso mo'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha'i bu gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ dpral bar trāṃ ser po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la aṃ aḥljang khu/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstshaswā hā/ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// nas/ shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/

spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapta 'i bar sbyar te mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog/ sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bhrūṃ yig bsrung bya sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī ཿaṃ a/ bdag dang bsrung bya la rakṣa rakṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes cung zad bzlas nas/ lag pa gnyis thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba'i mdzub mo'i tshigs gis bar pa bcag nas mtheb mdzub rtse sprad de/ gzungs ring*// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarb+ba trai lo kya pra ti bi shiṣṭā ya/ buddha ya te na maḥ tadya thā/ oṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ/ shodha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ asam sa manta/ a wa bhā sa spha ra ṇa ga ti/ ga ga na swa bhā ba bi shu ddhe// abhi ṣiñtsantu maṃ/ sarb+ba ta thā ga tā su ga tāḥ sugata pra ba tsa na/ a mṛ ta a bhi ṣi kai r/ ma hā mu drā mant+ra pa daiḥ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ma ma ā yussaṃ dhā ra ṇi/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bhi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na swabhā wa bi shuddhe/ uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shuddhe/ sa ha sra rasmi sañtso di te/ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki ni/ ṣaṭpā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi/ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta mā te/ da sha bhū mi pra tiṣṭhi te/ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre ma hā mu dre/ badzra kā ya saṃ ha tan pa ri shuddhe/ sarb+ba karm+ma ā ba ra ṇa bi shuddhe/ pra ti ni wart+ta ya ma ma ā yur/ bi shuddhe sarb+ba ta thā ga ta/ sa ma ya a dhiṣṭha na a dhiṣṭhi te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni ma hā bi mu ni/ ma ti ma ti ma hā ma te/ ma ma ti su ma ti ta thā tā/

bhū ta ko ṭi pa ri shuddhe/ bi sphu ṭa/ buddhe shuddhe/ he he dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma ra sma ra/ spha ra spha ra/ sphā ra ya sphā ra ya/ sarb+ba buddha a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te/ shuddhe shuddhe/ buddhe buddhe/ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ su badzre/ badzra garbhe dza ya garbhe/ bi dza ya garbhe/ badzra dzwā lā garbhe/ badzrodbha we/ badzra saṃ bha we/ badzre badzri ṇi/ badzrambha wantu mam sha rī raṃ/ sarb+ba satwā nāñtsa/ kā ya pa ri shuddhirbha wantu/ me sa dā sarb+ba ga ti pa ri shuddhishtsa/ sarb+ba ta thā ga tāshtsa/ māṃ sa mā shwa sa yantu/ budhya budhya/ sidhya sidhya/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bi bo dha ya bi bo dha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ sa mantān ྄motsa ya mo tsa ya/ sa manta rasmi pa ri shuddhe/ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a dhiṣṭhā na a dheṣṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre ma hā mu dre/ ma hā mu drā mant+ra pa daiḥswā hā/ oṃ bhrūṃ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurda de swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrāṃ hrīḥ.aṃ aḥrakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarb+ba satwāṃ shtsa swā hā/ bar tshang bar lan gcig ring phyag rgya bcas bzhin brjod/ de nas gzungs ring nyid ci nus bzlas shing sngags thung kyang bzla/ gzhan yang tshe spel ba'i gzungs 'di yang bzla ste/ oṃ a mṛ te/ amṛ tod bha we/ amṛ ta bi kran te/ a mṛ ta ga tre/ a mṛ ta gā mi ni/ a mṛ ta ā yu rdad de/ ga ga na kirti kha re sarba karma kle sha kṣa yaṃ ka rī ye swā hā/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs te a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ mdun rten mi dmigs pa/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/

nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i steng du paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i sa 'dzin gyi steng du them skas dang bcas pa'i khri la sna tshogs padma de'i steng du rin po che'i rang bzhin mchod rten bang rim zlum po gsum pa/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bre/ gdugs bcu gsum char khebs tog rnams brtsegs shing*/ me tog gi 'phreng ba dang*/ dar gyis lda ldis mdzes par byas pa/ de'i bum pa'i nang du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bhrūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rgyal ma zhes pa nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud ste dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnams sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyod bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u ṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u ṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mdun bskyed kyi lha la dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ nas/ shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyun par gyur/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams la gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta bsangs/ oṃ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rol mo dang*/ 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mthar klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā

sogs rigs 'gre bas shapta swā hā/ zhes byin gyis rlabs/ 'jig rten 'di 'am 'jig rten gzhan dag tu// mchod yon rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// mos blos bcom ldan lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin thog mtha' rigs 'gre bas/ zhabs bsil rnam pa ji snyed/ me tog rnam pa/ bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams tshig gi bsgyur kha byed/ de rjes slar yang stong mchod kyi zhal zas/ bdug spos/ mar me/ gdugs/ ba dan rnams la sger gyis dmigs te/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum/ mchod rdzas rnams phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad khyab par gang ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ 'jig rten 'di 'am 'jig rten gzhan dag na// lha bshos rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// mos blos= bzhes shig= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ 'jig rten= bdug spos rnam pa= mos= bzhes= oṃ= badzra dhū pe= 'jig rten= snang gsal rnam pa= mos= bzhes= badzra ā lo ke= 'jig rten 'di 'am= gdugs mchog rnam pa ji snyed= mos blos= bzhes shig= oṃ sarba= sa pa ri wā ra tshā traṃ ka pra= 'jig rten 'di'am= ba dan rnam pa= mos blos= bzhes shig= oṃ= pa taṃ ka pra tītstsha= de nas bstod pa 7kun mkhyen padma dkar pos mdzad pa 'dis bstod de/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i byin rlabs pad tshal gyis// rab dkar padma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan// rab dga' dri bzang phyogs dus kun 'gyed pa// rab mdzes bcom ldan ma der phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa zhal zla bzhin zhi ba g.yas ser bzhad// g.yon sngon mche bas ma mchu mnon pa'i zhal// re re'ang u tpal sngon 'dra'i spyan gsum pa// kun gzigs ma lus skyong der phyag 'tshal lo// phyag brgyad g.yas bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// 'od dpag med mgon mda' dang mchog sbyin te// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub zhags par bcas pa dang*// tshe bum gzhu 'dzin skyabs sbyin mdzad la 'dud// 'chi med na chung mchog gi gi lang tsho can// 'chi med gos dang rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma// 'chi med dbang po kun gyi phyag byas pa// 'chi med tshe sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// steng gi phyogs na gnas pa'i lha bu gnyis// gang la khrus gsol snam logs spyan ras gzigs// phyag na rdo rje rnga yab 'dzin pa dang*// pad dkar rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bzhir mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon can// stobs chen phyag g.yas ral gri lcags kyu dbyug

/rdo rje g.yon kun sdigs mdzub phyag rgya can// ma lus 'dul bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar bdag gi mos pas khyed bskul ba// de ltar khyod kyi dam bcas dgongs mdzad nas// tshe dbang longs spyod bsam pa'i don thams cad// myur du 'grub pa'i bka' drin stsal du gsol// stong mchod dngos ni/ thugs dam bskul ba'i phyag rgya sngar bshad des me tog bzung ste/ gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod rjes mdun bskyed la me tog 'thor/ slar yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā tā/ de bzhin rigs 'gres zhabs bsil nas/ shapta 'i bar dang*/ gdugs ba dan rnams kyis kyang mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur zhes brjod cing*/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar te mgo bo 'dud pa dang bcas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba trai lo kya pra ti bi shiṣṭā ya sogs nas sa tt+wāṃshtsa swā hā/ de ltar gzungs ring tshar bcu re bton pa'i rjes su/ mchod pa kha gsos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ sogs gong ltar mchod cing*/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba sogs/ shlau ka'i rjes/ rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs po che// gnas gtsang lha yi bu dang bcas pa yi// rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ yang gong bzhin gzungs ring bzla ba ste bcu tshan re song nas mchod bstod re bya/ gzungs bzla mkhan mi bcu yod pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzungs ring bcu tshan lan bcus gzungs stong phrag gcig 'gro ba yin pa las/ gzungs ring lnga brgya song nas bskor ba bya ste/ gzungs tshar re la dal bus bskor ba lan gnyis gnyis 'gro bar byas pas bskor ba yang stong 'gro/ 'dis rigs bsgres te/ gzungs zla mkhan mi lnga las med na/

gzungs ring bcu tshan lan grangs nyi shu 'gro dgos pa skabs thob mi grangs bstun nas shes dgos so// gtor ma stong bsngo ba ni/ stegs kyi steng du gtor theb bcu tshar bshams/ gtor theb re re'i nang du zan ril bcu bcu bzhag chu dang sbyar/ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad la dmigs nas/ a kā ro 'i sngags kyis gtor ma bsngo/ sngags brgya re'i mtshams su/ mchod spyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis// 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skong gyur cig /rigs drug gtor mas tshim gyur nas// lan chags bu lon khyer ba dang*// bla med byang chub myur thob shog/ ces 'dod don gsol zhing rol mo'i sgra bya'o// yang gtor ril gsar pa grangs gong mtshungs bshams nas bsngo ba de ltar lan bcus gtor ma stong 'gro/ yang na gtor ril rnams gtor snod du sdebs su bshams nas sngags a kā ro mi grangs rtsis pas stong bsags te bsngo ba yang yin no// mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ gong ltar badzra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ gzungs kyi mthar/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos/ mchod bstod bsdus pa la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces brjod/ de rjes cha gsum gtor ma gzhan du 'byung ba bzhin btang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bdag cag pus mo sa la gtsugs nas ni// thal sbyar khyed rnams la yang gsol 'debs na// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa rnams// gsan nas phan 'dogs slad du 'dir spyon zhig

/'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yul kun gnas dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// grong khyer kun na gang dag gnas pa dang*// chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gangs gnas dang*// rdzing dang mtsho dang lu ma lteng ka dang*// khron pa dang ni ngam grog chu mig dang*// grong dang phyug lhas dang ni nags tshal dang*// khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa dang*// gang dag gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas// bsod nams khyim dang glang po'i khang rnams dang*// gang dag rgyal po'i dkor khang gnas pa dang*// srang dang khyams dang grong gi 'dun sa dang*// gang dag shing gcig drung dang lam chen gnas// dur khrod dang ni nags tshal cher gnas dang*// seng ge glang chen dred kyi gnas rnams dang*// gang dag 'jigs rung dgon pa cher gnas dang*// chu gling mchog dag tu ni gnas byas dang*// gang dag 'brog dgon dur khrod dag na gnas// dga' zhing mgu nas dri ma me tog 'phreng*// spos dang me tog mar me gus phul ba// 'di dag bsnams te so sor bzhes nas kyang*// las 'di dag gi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// gdon la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir de ltar byas te/ de nas cha gcig la phyogs skyong rnams mchod par bya ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams brjod par bya'o// shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas// gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ lha rnams ma lus sa yi klu dag dang*// ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus la// so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di bzhes la// rang rang gi ni phyogs su bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad grogs dang g.yog 'khor bcas// dpung dang sde bcas mnyes nas bzhes su gsol// spos dang me tog gtor ma zhal zas ni// 'di dag bzhes shing so sor bsnams nas kyang*// bya ba 'di ni 'bras bu mchis par mdzod//

'di ni bgegs nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i don du 'am/ dgos pa gzhan 'dod pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrub par bya'o// gtor ma 'di la sngags rnams ni// kun tu 'byung ba med mod kyi// 'on kyang tshigs bcad tsam gyis ni// 'di ni gdon sogs tshim par 'gyur// dka' thub dang ni bden pa rnams// lhag pa yang dag thob 'gyur ba// bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' lung ni// 'di ltar sngags dang mtshungs par 'dod// bslu ba med pa'i tshig gang yin// de ni gsang sngags nyid du 'dod// mu stegs kyis ni bgrangs pa'i sngags// de nyid phyir ni tshad ma min// de bas dngos grub thob rnams kyi// tshig gang de sngags nyid yin te// spyod lam bzhi po 'di dag ni// phyag rgya nyid du bshad pa yin// de bas gtor ma'i las 'di la// tshig bshad gsang sngags nyid du 'grub// de bas 'di ni swā hā sogs// spel ba'i sngags ni dgos pa med// de ni gdon dang phyogs skyong gi gtor ma'i cho ga'o// cha gcig bgegs la byin te/ hūm̐/ gang dag mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug dang*// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang por bcas// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// zhes bya bas bsngo bar bya'o// rjes chog ni mchod pa kha gsos/ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i sogs gong ltar nas/ shapta swā hā bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste// mchod yon sna tshogs rab tu bkram byas te/

bdag nyid chen mo rnam par rgyal ma mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin zhabs bsil sogs rigs 'gres sbyar te mchod pa'am/ sngags mchod rkyang pa gang bde'i mthar/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis bstod/ thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing tshe dpal rgyas pa sogs mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol// yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis mchod rten dang ras bris la dmigs te/ brtan bzhugs bya/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya'o// tshe dbang ma lus ster ba'i bcom ldan mar// mchod pa'i cho ga 'di nyid bsgrubs pa las// byung ba'i dge bas bdag gzhan sems can kun// 'chi med bde ba mchog gi dpal thob shog/ ces bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma bsnyen cing stong mchod sgrub pa'i lag len 'di nyid/ sngar gyi mkhas pa'i yig cha cung zad mi 'dra ba kha shas yongs 'dug cing*/ grags che ba'i lugs stong mchod byed tshul bklag chog lta bur bkod pa 'di bzhin/ shes bya yangs pa dbon mi pham bstan 'dzin phrin las rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 7mi pham kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba'i ming can gyis 'khrigs su bkod pa'o// sarba madga laṃ/// /
